notes: Paper establishes a NEW exclusion bound from Pioneer Venus Orbiter (PVO) observations of SN 1987A in the 0.2–2 MeV energy window. The fireball formation mechanism allows axions with masses ~1–60 MeV and couplings ~few×10^-10 GeV^-1 to escape previous SMM constraints. The entire fireball formation region (shown as hatched blue in Fig. 2) is robustly excluded by PVO non-observation of sub-MeV photons. The paper states 'the entire region of fireball formation is excluded on the basis of the PVO non-observation' and notes that 'the total energy E is always larger than 5×10^48 erg, namely more than five orders of magnitude higher than the approximate exclusion.' The bound is approximately mass-independent across the fireball region (1–60 MeV) at ~10^-10 GeV^-1, encoded as a horizontal line.
